label: ASC AI Model Version 1
summary: Initial Teachable Machine cloud-cover and rain classifiers for the Pomfret all-sky camera (~900 training images per cloud model).

bundles.Day_Cloud_Model: Cloud cover, nautical dawn → nautical dusk
bundles.Night_Cloud_Model: Cloud cover, nautical dusk → nautical dawn
bundles.Day_Rain_Model: Rain vs no rain, day phase
bundles.Night_Rain_Model: Rain vs no rain, night phase

notes: Future ASC AI Model Version 2 (v2) may replace these weights; keep this file when bumping versions.
